name: alyr-platform
description: Heldat web, prototype, native, and shared product contracts.

scripts.check: npm run check:shared && npm run check:api-contract && npm run check:supabase:static && npm run check:backup-restore && npm run check:site && npm run check:web && npm run check:mobile-prototype && npm run check:native && npm run check:ios-preview
scripts.check:api-contract: npm run generate:api && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/src/generated/api.ts
scripts.check:supabase:static: node --test supabase/tests/schema.test.mjs supabase/tests/household_creation_idempotency.test.mjs supabase/tests/export_completion.test.mjs supabase/tests/property_value_sync.test.mjs supabase/tests/liability_net_position.test.mjs supabase/tests/product_event_idempotency.test.mjs supabase/tests/signup_and_api_controls.test.mjs supabase/tests/launch_enrollment_controls.test.mjs supabase/tests/asset_metadata_sync.test.mjs supabase/tests/request_controls.test.mjs supabase/tests/request_body.test.mjs supabase/tests/backend_readiness.test.mjs supabase/tests/blob_store.test.mjs supabase/tests/blob_store_static.test.mjs supabase/tests/sync_retention_and_bootstrap.test.mjs supabase/tests/sync_and_blob_maintenance_schedule.test.mjs supabase/tests/api_capacity_probe.test.mjs supabase/tests/free_tier_quota_guard.test.mjs supabase/tests/storage_capacity_error_contract.test.mjs supabase/tests/household_storage_usage.test.mjs
scripts.check:supabase:local: npx --yes supabase@2.109.1 db lint --local --level warning && npx --yes supabase@2.109.1 test db
scripts.deploy:supabase:api: npm run check:supabase:static && npx --yes supabase@2.109.1 db push --linked --include-all --yes && npx --yes supabase@2.109.1 functions deploy api --project-ref ifiyragzeizaxdqzxvpk --no-verify-jwt --use-api --yes && npm run probe:supabase:live
scripts.check:web: npm run test:domain --workspace=asset-continuity-web && npm run test:server --workspace=asset-continuity-web && npm run test:ui --workspace=asset-continuity-web -- --maxWorkers=2 --testTimeout=15000 && npm run test:sites --workspace=asset-continuity-web && npm run build --workspace=asset-continuity-web
scripts.check:mobile-prototype: npm run build --workspace=asset-continuity-mobile && npm run test:sites --workspace=asset-continuity-mobile
scripts.check:native: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@alyr/native && npm run test --workspace=@alyr/native && npm run test:e2e:static --workspace=@alyr/native && npm run config:check --workspace=@alyr/native && npm run config:check:production --workspace=@alyr/native && npm run verify:eas-packaging --workspace=@alyr/native && npm run verify:recovery-crypto --workspace=@alyr/native
scripts.check:ios-preview: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@alyr/ios-preview && npm run test:contract --workspace=@alyr/ios-preview && npm run config:check --workspace=@alyr/ios-preview && npm run bundle:ios --workspace=@alyr/ios-preview
scripts.dev:native: npm run build:shared && npm run start --workspace=@alyr/native
scripts.dev:ios-preview: npm run build:shared && npm run start:lan --workspace=@alyr/ios-preview
